text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release=edge-client-2023.10.4 -> canary (region: us-west1). image: registry.redwood/edge-client:2023.10.4 :rocket:

alex: seeing a spike in 500s from the canary pods, @sre_lead can you take a look?

maya: adding DNS and upstream checks — might be contract mismatch with client side. quick grep shows schema version header changed to `X-Client-Schema: 3`

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2023-1699001010 (sev: p2) — on-call: @sre_lead — please acknowledge :rotating_light:

sre_lead: acknowledged. digging in. alex, can you paste a representative error payload?

alex: sure, here's a sample from the canary logs:
```
ERROR 2023-11-03T15:14:22Z upstream:400 {"error":"BadRequest","message":"unknown field 'client_metadata.schema'"}
Trace: com.redwood.rpc.SchemaValidationException: Unexpected field 'client_metadata.schema'\n    at com.redwood.api.v2.SchemaValidator.validate(SchemaValidator.java:87)
```

patrick: which client ship triggered this? SDK v4.2 rolled yesterday. rollout image includes handshake adapter that bumps schema header.

maya: confirmed: client header now `X-Client-Schema: 3` while server expected `2`. some fields were made optional on client but server treats them strictly -> proto mismatch.

sre_lead: good catch. do we have canary traffic split?

deploy-bot: Traffic split at canary: 5% -> 95% stable. Canary pods: 3 healthy, 2 failing healthchecks. Autoscaler keeping stable.

sre_lead: since canary sees 40% error rate on streaming/paging endpoints, we need to kill the rollout flag and initiate rollback. @patrick, flip kill-switch FF `edge-client-schema-v3` to OFF.

patrick: flipping FF `edge-client-schema-v3` -> OFF now.

patrick: (reacted :white_check_mark:) feature flag toggle confirmed by config-service (req id: cfg-5a3f).

deploy-bot: Observed reduction in failed requests within 30s of FF toggle. Errors on canary down from 40% -> 2%.

customer-support: drafting customer-facing note: "We detected increased errors affecting paging/streaming in a small percentage of requests after a client-side schema change. We rolled back the release and disabled the feature flag. No data loss and most customers unaffected. More details to follow." Want to post to status.redwood.com?

maya: please hold posting until rollback completes and we have final numbers.

sre_lead: starting rollback of release=edge-client-2023.10.4 -> rolling back canary images to previous tag registry.redwood/edge-client:2023.10.3.

deploy-bot: rollback job initiated (job id: rb-1699002045).

alex: I'm seeing streaming sessions time out during the flip, small window (30-45s). Tracking sessions that errored and queueing follow-up for session resume.

deploy-bot: rollback completed successfully at 2023-11-03T15:35:12Z. Canary back to 2023.10.3. All canary pods healthy.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2023-1699001010 updated: status -> mitigated. Assigned to @sre_lead. Severity downgraded to p3 pending RCA.

customer-support: posting brief status update now to status.redwood.com and CS channels.

customer-support: posted — "Mitigated: A canary rollout introduced a client/server schema mismatch causing elevated errors on paging/streaming endpoints. We disabled the feature flag and rolled back the canary. Monitoring continues."

lina: good catch. follow-ups: 1) immediate hotfix to make server lenient on unknown client fields for next minor; 2) add pre-rollout schema compat checks in CI; 3) update SDK release notes to call out header bump.

patrick: I'll revert the handshake adapter commit on the release branch and open PR for a safer rollout plan.

maya: add an automated contract compatibility test to the canary pipeline that validates `X-Client-Schema` variations and unknown keys.

sre_lead: agreed. owners: patrick (SDK/release), maya (canary tests/CI), alex (session resume instrumentation), lina (postmortem). I'll run the RCA doc. ETA initial postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow.

sre_lead: next immediate action items logged in INC ticket. tagging @everyone involved. thanks for quick responses.

incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 2023-11-03T16:00Z — next on-call: @carla.

alex: leaving a note for CARLA: monitoring chest of canary metrics, watch `paging.error_rate` for spikes >5%

lina: also suggest a short runbook addendum: "If schema mismatch detected, immediately toggle feature-flag and hold rollout; run compatibility suite; then resume with 0.5% traffic increments."

sre_lead: agreed. I'll add the runbook. Closing thread for active mitigation, keeping incident ticket open for RCA and customer outreach."
